integrity_notes: Closed-form corner integration and strict balancing proof are analytic; standalone verification supplements but is not a proof. Classical 2014 centroid probability and corner decomposition are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one independent arclength-uniform sample on each of three sides; exact probabilities, fixed target, nondegenerate Euclidean triangles. Strict majorization applies only to interior barycentric triples; boundary profile is zero. No arbitrary-polygon or perimeter-iid result, and no statistical stability claim.
title: An exact barycentric coverage profile and strict majorization law for side-sampled triangles
